text: They need to learn what customer service means. They left me waiting inside then waiting outside. Also the response below is talking about a technical issue, thats not me. Must be a other customer they pissed off.

This place is a complete rip-off. I went in because my radio stopped working, and they immediately told me I needed a brand-new radio. I paid for it, they installed it, and the problem was still there.

Then they claimed my factory amp was bad and sold me a new one too. After spending all that money, they still didn’t fix the issue. On top of that, the installation work was terrible. The new radio is slow, and now my A/C doesn’t even work.

They promised they would make it right, but once they had my money, they stopped responding completely. In my opinion, they sold me parts I didn’t need and did a sloppy job. The only reason they have so many good reviews is because they offer discounts to customers who leave 5-star ratings.
